evals.prompt: I just cloned this repo. Discover the project stack, scripts, and build commands.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs detect_stack.py, discovers the manifest files, executes build/test commands to verify exit codes, and updates project-context.json.
expectations: The skill executes python scripts/detect_stack.py to analyze workspace manifests
Discovered build, test, and lint commands are executed and exit codes are recorded
Stack information is saved in .agent/context/project-context.json under stack and commands keys

evals.prompt: What frameworks, database, and package manager does this codebase use?
evals.expected_output: The skill inspects package manifests and ORM configs to identify languages, frameworks, and database tools.
expectations: The output lists languages, frameworks, ORMs, and package manager without guessing
The handoff file contains an empirical summary of discovered project dependencies
No .env secrets or API keys are printed in the discovery output

evals.prompt: Run the project test suite and record whether the test command succeeds.
evals.expected_output: The skill identifies the exact test command from the manifest, executes it, and records the exit code in context.
expectations: The test command is executed directly rather than assumed
The exit code of the test command is recorded under commands.test.last_exit
The status of the test suite is updated in project-context.json
